common.footer: You received this email because of activity on your {{appName}} account. If this wasn't you, contact support and change your password.

confirm_email.subject: Confirm your email for {{appName}}
confirm_email.heading: Confirm your email address
body: Select the button below to confirm this address and activate your account. The link expires in 24 hours.

account_exists.subject: Sign-in attempt for your {{appName}} account
account_exists.heading: You already have an account
body: Someone tried to register with this email address. If it was you, sign in instead or reset your password.

reset_password.subject: Reset your {{appName}} password
reset_password.heading: Reset your password
body: Select the button below to choose a new password. The link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your {{appName}} password was changed
password_changed.heading: Password changed
body: Your password was just changed and other sessions were signed out. If you didn't do this, contact support immediately.

mfa_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned off
mfa_disabled.heading: Two-factor authentication turned off
body: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your account. Withdrawals require it, so turn it back on before your next withdrawal. If you didn't do this, contact support immediately.

new_device_login.subject: New sign-in to your {{appName}} account
new_device_login.heading: New sign-in detected
body: Your account was signed in to from a new network or device ({{userAgent}}).
If this was you, no action is needed. If not, change your password and contact support.

wallet_confirmation.subject: Confirm your new withdrawal address
wallet_confirmation.heading: Your confirmation code: {{code}}
body: You added the withdrawal address “{{label}}” on {{network}}: {{address}}
Enter this code to confirm it. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes. New addresses can receive withdrawals after a security waiting period.
If you didn't add this address, don't share the code — change your password and contact support.

deposit_credited.subject: Deposit credited: {{amount}} {{asset}}
deposit_credited.heading: Your deposit was credited
body: {{amount}} {{asset}} (reference {{reference}}) is now in your balance.
New deposits can be withdrawn after the holding period shown in your dashboard; they can be invested right away.

withdrawal_created.subject: Withdrawal requested: {{reference}}
withdrawal_created.heading: Withdrawal request received
body: You requested a withdrawal of {{amount}} {{asset}} to {{address}}. After fees you will receive {{netAmount}} {{asset}}.
The amount is reserved while our team reviews the request. If you didn't request this, contact support immediately.

withdrawal_completed.subject: Withdrawal sent: {{reference}}
withdrawal_completed.heading: Your withdrawal was sent
body: {{amount}} {{asset}} was sent on the blockchain.
Transaction: {{txHash}}

withdrawal_rejected.subject: Withdrawal not approved: {{reference}}
withdrawal_rejected.heading: Your withdrawal was not approved
body: Reason: {{reason}}
The full amount has been returned to your available balance.

withdrawal_failed.subject: Withdrawal could not be sent: {{reference}}
withdrawal_failed.heading: Your withdrawal could not be sent
body: Reason: {{reason}}
Nothing left the platform wallet, and the full amount has been returned to your available balance.
